coverage_note: 00:00-06:40 English setup talk about the verb list; 53:30-1:04 mostly English review (rule recap in Latin letters: awwal il marra, nafs il ishi, qaid = 8eir). Engine: 43:20 هذا الثاني = Amal's echo حدا التاني; 07:54 'كان قنيش' garbled. Echo candidates checked: all real English answers in drills, none Arabic. 09:44 أخد = aa5ud (fine). 1:04:01 أشوفك/شوفك farewell not filed.

rows.medi_said: أنا سمعت / متأخر اليوم. صحيت. That's right.
rows.why: He said sme3et (I heard) for 'I woke up'; Amal said صحيت and he repeated it with 'That's right' (GR-24).

rows.medi_said: أأأ أنا صحيت تأخير.
rows.why: He used the noun ta2kheer (delay) for the adjective mit2a55er; Amal voiced 'إنت صحيت متأخر' and he repeated 'أنا صحيت متأخر' at 08:39.

rows.medi_said: آآآ على عشرة.
rows.why: Clock time needs el-: Amal's whole reply was 'الـ' and he said على العشرة at 07:38 (GR-25/GR-28: one slip).

rows.medi_said: Okay أنا شوي-- أنا كان قنيش شوي--
rows.why: kaan needs the I-ending: Amal recast 'أنا كنت' and he said أنا كنت شوي at 08:01.

rows.medi_said: هادي الصباح. / هاد الصباح.
rows.amal_said: We never say هذا الصبح just say الصبح or بالصباح.
rows.proposed_rule: 'This morning' is just el-subu7 or bel-saba7 - never hada/hadi + el-saba7: ana kunet shwai kasool el-subu7
rows.why: 'This morning' takes no demonstrative in Levantine; Amal said explicitly we never say هذا الصبح (he also first used fem هادي with masc الصباح).
rows.english: I was a bit lazy this morning.

rows.medi_said: شجاع اليوم. متشجاع اليوم.
rows.why: shuja3 = brave, not motivated; Amal recast متشجع (confusables group mitshajje3/shuja3).

rows.medi_said: أنا لازم / آآآ عطلة و
rows.why: laazem went straight to a noun; Amal supplied the verb in English ('you should take') and he said لازم أخد عطلة (GR-27).
rows.english: I need to take a vacation.

rows.medi_said: أنا لازم أخد عطلة وسفر، سفر.
rows.why: He used the noun safar where the verb asaafer is needed; Amal rephrased in English 'I should travel' and he said ولازم أسافر (PG-22).

rows.medi_said: أنا خططت / سفر، / سفرة / بسفر / على سفر
rows.why: khattat takes la-; Amal prompted 'You plan for.' and he tried بسفر / على سفر without landing la- (her chat: la-safra).

rows.medi_said: جاي-- أسبوع الجاي.
rows.why: Noun + el-adjective needs el- on the noun too; Amal let it pass, her chat wrote el-usboo3 el-jaay.

rows.medi_said: بس أنا راح / آآآ على / عند / عموي.
rows.amal_said: Sorry بس أنا راح what?. / راح going. What's going؟
rows.why: ra7 needs a bare verb after it; Amal asked 'راح what? What's going?' and he said راح أروح at 11:52.
rows.english: But I'm going to my uncle's.

rows.medi_said: راح أروح على / عند عموي.
rows.amal_said: Either على or عند which one؟ Can't put two.
rows.why: He stacked two prepositions; Amal said you can't put two, pick one (عند).

rows.medi_said: عموي. / عند عموي
rows.why: His form عموي for 'my uncle'; Amal recast عمي twice (her chat allows 3ammi/o).

rows.medi_said: راح بنجح؟
rows.amal_said: No. It's the whole-- It's the reason of our whole one month long lesson.
rows.why: nenja7 (succeed) is the wrong verb for 'have fun'; Amal said No and pointed him to the drilled verb, he said ننبسط and she said صح.

rows.medi_said: تش- تشكيل؟ / Tesh-- Was it tesh-- What was it?
rows.why: He forgot the word for camping and asked; Amal gave a hint then تخييم (didn't-know).

rows.medi_said: عشا، ألفين ستة وعشرين
rows.why: For 'thirteen' he said 3asha (dinner); Amal echoed عشاء and asked what it is, he said عشرة and 'is that dinner?'.

rows.medi_said: And if I say el awal elsaa, that means the f-- the, the...
rows.amal_said: Nothing. / It would be the first if the أول is after.
rows.why: He proposed el-awal el-saa3a for 'the first hour'; Amal said it means nothing - the adjective goes after (meta statement, may be ruled a rule question).

rows.medi_said: Okay, so الساعة الأول
rows.why: Feminine saa3a takes el-oola; Amal recast أولى.

rows.medi_said: and تاني الساعة means a different hour.
rows.amal_said: لا. We can't say تاني الساعة. It doesn't mean anything.
rows.why: taani before the noun never goes with el-; Amal said it doesn't mean anything (said while stating the rule).

rows.medi_said: هذي اليوم التانية.
rows.amal_said: مم، مم، هذي اليوم. / مرة، هذي المرة.
rows.chat: hadi el-marra el-tania illi bashufek elyoam
rows.why: He said el-yoam (the day) for el-marra (the time); Amal echoed his word then said مرة، هذي المرة and he rebuilt المرة التانية.
rows.english: This is the second time (I see you today).

rows.medi_said: So ساعة الأول-- It should be ساعة الأول.
rows.why: Feminine noun needs el-oola; Amal recast أولى and he said ساعة الأولى.

rows.medi_said: ساعة الأولى
rows.why: Noun + el-adjective: the noun needs el- too; Amal recast الساعة الأولى.

rows.medi_said: الأول الـ اليوم. / الأول اليوم. No, that's the-- Isn't that the first day?
rows.why: For 'the first day' the adjective goes after: Amal said 'Nothing' and gave اليوم الأول; he said 'that's right'.

rows.medi_said: And then مرة, uh, مرة الأخير.
rows.why: marra is feminine so a5eera; after Amal's 'Now/No' he said مرة الأخيرة.

rows.medi_said: مرة الأخيرة.
rows.why: Noun needs el- with the el-adjective; Amal recast المرة الأخيرة and he repeated it.

rows.medi_said: الرحلة أخيرة.
rows.why: Repeating her phrase he dropped el- on the adjective; Amal said الأخيرة and he repeated it.

rows.medi_said: غير يوم." "غير اليوم." I'll see you another day.
rows.chat: bashufek 8eir yoam = i'll see you another day
rows.why: 8eir never takes el- on the noun after it; Amal recast غير يوم.

rows.medi_said: ال، الختيارة / ال / أوّل؟ Is it awwal?
rows.why: Feminine 5ityaara needs el-oola; Amal recast الأولى and he said 'أولى, goddammit'.
rows.english: She is the first old woman in our program.

rows.medi_said: Yes, uh, tan-- uh, تاني، / تاني حدا.
rows.amal_said: تاني حدا would mean the second person.
rows.why: For 'someone else' taani goes after the noun; Amal said تاني حدا means the second person, he then said حدا تاني.

rows.medi_said: Oh, you're right. Uh, هذا الثاني.
rows.amal_said: حدا التاني is / no. X. Just حدا تاني.
rows.why: Amal's echo shows he said 7ada el-taani (engine wrote هذا الثاني); she said no, just حدا تاني.

rows.medi_said: آخر / عشرة / دقايق. عشرة دقايق؟
rows.amal_said: صح. / عشر y. / y عشر not عشرة.
rows.why: Before a counted noun ten is 3ashar not 3ashra; Amal said 'عشر not عشرة' and he said عشر دقايق.

rows.medi_said: العشر دقايق / الـ، / الآخر. / أخير، أخيرة
rows.why: After the noun the adjective is a5eer and must agree with plural da2aaye2; Amal prompted أخي- then gave أخيرات.

rows.medi_said: Yeah، آخر الموظفة, right?
rows.chat: min aa5er muwazzafe/a / min el-muwazzafa el-a5ira
rows.why: aa5er + el- means 'the end of'; Amal asked 'The end of the employees?' and he said مين آخر موظفة.

rows.medi_said: you say it was dwarf? What was it again?
rows.why: He did not know 'guests' and asked her to repeat it; Amal gave ضيوف (didn't-know).

rows.medi_said: And then what's كل اليوم ? It's, uh, all the days.
rows.why: kul + el- = all / the whole: Amal recast 'All day' (an English rule question, may not count).

rows.medi_said: نفس الطريقة
rows.chat: ana basoo2 nafs el-taree2 kul yom
rows.why: tari2a = way/method, not route; Amal said طريق and asked what طريقة is, he said نفس الطريق.
rows.english: I drive the same route every day.
